Job description

Turn Pricing Into Perfect Matches


At Shaadi.com, we don t just help people find love-we build products that make millions of journeys possible. We re looking for a sharp, high-energy Product Manager to own our Pricing Promotions pods, where every experiment, offer, and price point directly shapes growth, conversion, and revenue.
If you love decoding user behaviour, running high-impact experiments, and turning data into business wins, this role is your kind of match.

What You ll Own
Own the product strategy, roadmap, and execution for pricing, promotions, offers, and monetisation initiatives across Shaadi.com.
Design and launch pricing models, discounting strategies, subscription offers, and campaign-led promotions that drive conversions without compromising long-term value.
Use analytics, A/B tests, and user research to identify opportunities, validate hypotheses, and measure impact on revenue, retention, and user experience.
Partner closely with Tech, Design, Data, Marketing, Finance, and Business teams to ship initiatives end to end.
Monitor key metrics-conversion, ARPU, revenue, uptake, churn, and margin-and translate insights into clear product decisions.
Balance user delight with business outcomes: build offers that feel valuable to members while driving sustainable growth.


Who We re Looking For
2-4 years of product management experience, ideally in pricing, promotions, growth, monetisation, or B2C product roles.
Experience at a top consumer-facing organisation is strongly preferred-someone who understands scale, speed, and user-first thinking.
MBA from a top B-school is preferred.
High IQ, strong structured thinking, and the ability to simplify complex trade-offs quickly.
Comfortable with data: funnels, cohorts, experiments, pricing elasticity, and business metrics.
A builder s mindset: proactive, ownership-driven, comfortable with ambiguity, and excited to ship fast.


Why Shaadi.com
Work on one of India s most iconic consumer internet brands, with real impact on millions of users.
Own high-visibility pricing and promotions pods where your decisions move the business.
Be based in Mumbai, working onsite with product, tech, and business leaders.
